dimensions.note: No credential inputs, external clients, or secret-bearing outputs.
record logs structured entry and completion/replay messages without packet content.
Malformed input, packet ID mismatch, tampered stored data, and conflicting replay fail before persistence.
Synthetic tests cover strict/malformed input, approval and authority tampering, privacy downgrade, freshness, exact replay, conflicting replay, stored-data tampering, and absence of send surfaces.
Exact replay returns without a second write; changed content under an existing identity fails closed.
No external API calls or delivery integration.
No network, subprocess, file, or temporary-resource lifecycle.
README and fixtures contain only synthetic/example identifiers and no private infrastructure.
Arguments and every persisted packet object are strict and bounded; unknown fields are rejected.
packet explicitly declares infinite lifetime and garbageCollection 20.
Purposefully append-only draft recorder, not a CRUD lifecycle controller.
No external mutation; full validation, identity, and replay checks precede the sole local persistence write.
The sole writer targets packet with its validated packetId; no cross-spec collision is possible.
Existing state is accessed only through context.readResource.
Initial standalone publication; registry reports no prior published version.
